docs.title: [GET] forecast statistics
docs.text: /api/statistics/forecast

docs.title: RequestDTO
docs.text:
Bases: BaseModel

Attributes:

Name Type Description site_id int

Identifier of the site whose forecast statistics are requested.

hour_ahead float

Forecast horizon in hours used to evaluate historical prediction accuracy (FPE/MAPE). Forwarded to the processing stage.

pht_date date

The calendar day (PHT / UTC+8) to report on. May be today or a past date; drives the start/end of the meter-reading window below.

docs.title: meter_readings_start_pht property
docs.text: Start of the meter-reading window, in PHT — the first of pht_date's month.

docs.title: ForecastStatisticsOutputDTO
docs.text:
Bases: BaseModel

Output of the statistics stage — the summary statistic values.

Attributes:

Name Type Description mean_average_percentage RoundedFloat(2)

MAPE (%) — mean of the per-interval Forecast Percentage Errors over the whole FPE window (month-to-date). None when the window contains no metered energy.

peak_power RoundedFloat(2)

Highest actual power (kW) recorded so far on the current day. None when the window contains no metered energy.

perc95 RoundedFloat(2)

95th percentile (%) of the per-interval FPE values over the same window as mean_average_percentage. None when the window contains no metered energy.

predicted_15min RoundedFloat(2)

Mean predicted power (kW) over the next three 5-minute slots. None when no future slots remain in the day.

predicted_5min RoundedFloat(2)

Predicted power (kW) for the next 5-minute slot. None when no future slots remain in the day.

predicted_energy RoundedFloat(2)

Projected total energy (kWh) for the day — actual energy value up to the cut-off plus predictions for the remainder, integrated via the trapezoidal rule.

predicted_peak RoundedFloat(2)

Highest predicted power (kW) across the full day (historical predictions plus the forward-looking range).

docs.title: How it's different from the old implementation:
docs.text: • The return parameters are different. Previously, we used to assign the transformer to the outgoing_meter parameter and had the meter in the main_meter parameter. The problem is that both words mean the same thing so it is now revised to just meter and transformer while the feeder_meters stay the same.

docs.title: Important Notes:

• Just check if the status code is 200 which indicates that the session token is still valid.

    • the session token has expired
